notes.title: Small Update (Typos)
notes.content:
Hi all,

Just a quick update to fix some typos pointed out by Sootopolis. Thanks!

Also, if you're having trouble getting the High Price ending and keep getting Echo instead:

[spoiler]That's because the goblets are somewhat random. You'll know you're getting the Echo ending if the player feels cold from drinking from the goblet. Scroll back and pick a different goblet. The player should feel warm.[/spoiler].

I'll add this to the guide later.

notes.title: Update Nov 24 (Adds Spanish Translation)
notes.content:
Hello,

This update adds a Spanish (Castilian) translation courtesy of Ana Alcocer!

Languages can be changed by navigating to the Preferences section and selecting Spanish (Español) from the menu.

That's all for now.

S. A. Welland
